The charr maintain a heavily fortified stronghold in the northwest (the location for [[Assault on the Stronghold]] mission). Large tribes of [[grawl]] dominate the northeast and southwest. Towards the southeastern corner one will find large a number of [[elemental]]s, most notable amongst them are the fire elementals that created an inferno out of a forest in the southeast corner. There are two dungeon entrances in the area; [[Rragar's Menagerie]] to the southwest, and [[Catacombs of Kathandrax]] to the southeast. ==Quests available== *[[Sergeant Weststar]] **[[The Hunting of [[Forbidden Fruit]]) ** [[Locked Chest]] ([[Chest]]) == Notes == * This is the only location where players can [[Charm Animal|tame]] a [[Raven]]. * The charr stronghold is inaccessible if any party member has not completed [[Assault on the Stronghold]]. It is possible to have completed Assault on the Stronghold without having completed the other charr missions in the same mode (by alternating Normal and Hard mode), in which case the stronghold will also be inaccessible. ** If any party member has [[Forbidden Fruit]] active, the western back entrance will be open. ** If any party member has [[Single Ugly Grawl Seeks Same for Mindless Destruction in Ascalon]] active, the southern path leading into the stronghold will be accessible. ** Players can still enter the stronghold by exploiting [[Dismount Siege Devourer]] right at the front gate, facing away from it. *{{Vanquisher|count = 429|low = 390|high = 468}} ** The southeastern area is teeming with [[Burning Spirit]]s and [[Flowstone Elemental]]s, making it arguably the most dangerous part due to the high number of spells dealing [[AoE]] fire damage. *** Remember to keep spread out. *** Keep an eye out for patrolling groups of [[Burning Spirit]]s, especially the one including [[Borrguus Blisterbark]]; they move quickly along a circular route and can quickly overwhelm your party. *** Bring skills for party-wide damage mitigation and/or elemental resistance such as [[Ward Against Harm]]. Party-wide caster shutdown tactics, especially Daze (e.g. using [[Technobabble]]) and interrupt (e.g. using [[Complicate]]) are also advised to counter [[Searing Flames]], [[Fire Storm]] and [[Savannah Heat]]. *** A single well-placed [[Pain Inverter]] there is usually a guaranteed kill. ** There are four [[boss]]es in the [[Charr]] stronghold (after completion of [[Assault on the Stronghold]]), which makes it worth saving until you have a [[Boss Bounty]]. Approach from the west or south, to avoid the well-defended eastern entrance ([[Charr Seeker]]s stand atop the ridge, making it hard to get close without taking significant damage). ** [[Fozzy Yeoryios]] is in a group with a lot of potent healing; it can be difficult to kill them without the proper counters. ** As with any area in the Charr Homelands, if at least two player [[character]]s are in the party, several [[Siege Devourer]] can be mounted which can make vanquishing much easier. ** For a complete Vanquish all worms in the southwest corner have to be killed. {{anomaly|The flaming spirits surrounding [[Borrguus Blisterbark]] will shout phrases normally attributed to the Charr, e.g. ''"For the warband!"''.}} {{bug|After extended periods of time, the animation of the fire in the burning forest will freeze and will not resume until you have exited and restarted the game.}}
